**Finding: T4C — compliant (preferred level).**

- **Customer convenience right:** § 9.4 lets Customer terminate the Agreement *or any Order Form* without cause; § 29.4 sets that notice at **thirty days**, matching the preferred 30-day standard.
- **No penalty:** Customer "owes only accrued Fees." No early-termination fee, wind-down charge, or penalty appears in § 7 (Fees), § 10 (Effect of Termination), or § 11 (Transition).
- **Pro-rata refund:** § 9.4 requires refund of prepaid Fees for the period after termination, reinforced by § 10.2 (prepaid recurring Fees covering the post-termination period).
- **No Vendor convenience right:** Across the document Vendor may terminate only for material breach (§ 9.1) and insolvency (§ 9.2). The § 8.2 renewal opt-out is Customer-only, and § 24.4 bars termination on Customer change of control — so nothing gives Vendor a mid-term walk-away during the three-year term (§ 8.1).

No redline proposed; the clause sits at our preferred position.
